items.note: In a 4-column grid of outlined cards on band-colour squares, the hovered first card lifts -4px with a hard ink offset shadow at its lower-right. The other cards stay flush, and the yellow or teal band with its pill filters sits above.

On the black ground, the hovered card's whole outer box lifts and shows the light offset shadow while the other cards stay flat. The band, the paper current-page pill and the pink price tags all read clearly.

In the single-column card stack, the first card is lifted with its hard shadow. The band collapses to the title plus a pill strip that scrolls past the edge, and filters and sort sit in one column below it.

The product page has a band title with a breadcrumb, a framed tote sticker on yellow, a pink price tag and a pink lifted Add to cart button. Below it, an inline pink check line confirms the item was added and links to the cart, and the header count shows 1.

In dark, the same inline confirmation sits under the pink Add to cart button with a pink check and an underlined View cart link. The selected colour pill is raised and readable, and the count badge in the header updates.

The layout is one column: framed sticker, price tag, colour pills, a stepper, then the lifted pink button. The two-line confirmation underneath wraps cleanly and says what was added, with a link to the cart.

The Checkout card opens with a summary line (one sample puts it in a subtle well with a red border). Each empty field has a red border and an icon-plus-sentence message, the first field has the ink border and pink halo focus, and the only pink action is Place order.
In dark, the error borders and messages are red on the raised card, the focused first field shows the pink halo ring, and the summary line says how many fields to fix. Everything is readable.
The cart and checkout cards stack in one column, with per-field red messages and a focused first field with a halo. In one sample, the line-item product name in the cart card is set bold.
Focus sits on the Cart nav pill next to the ink Shop current-page pill, shown as an outline ring. This is the flush-ring case critic-1 already raised, and nothing else on the shop grid changes.
In dark, the focused Cart pill carries a clear pink ring beside the paper current-page pill, so it is easy to see which control has focus.
In the mobile header, the focus ring sits on the Cart pill under the brand row, next to the ink Shop pill. The band and the card stack are unchanged.

Eleven different flat stickers sit on rotating band colours: tote, backpack, duffel, sweater, tee, coat, mug, skillet, towels, key ring and beanie. Each has a heavy ink outline, pink, band or raised fills only, and a slight tilt, and no two items share a drawing, as with the reference's varied product squares.

The detail image is a tilted pink tote with a handle arc and an inset pocket on a yellow square, with a heavy outline. It clearly reads as a bag in all three samples, though one sample draws it small in a tall frame.
A pink crew-neck sweater with a ribbed hem sits on a band square and reads as a knit top. In one sample, the cuff strokes run past the sleeve outline and the hem line is loose.

The empty cart shows one sticker on paper. Two samples use a tilted pink coin with an extruded yellow rim and a heavy plus glyph, as in the recipe, and one uses an open yellow box with pink and raised flaps.

findings.summary: In the cart summary, the line-item product name is bold, while the spec keeps all type at regular weight and allows bold only for totals and inline emphasis.
The sweater sticker's cuff and hem strokes overshoot the garment outline, so it looks less finished than the other stickers and the reference's clean flat artwork.
